title: The profiler's file on you is disturbingly accurate
dek: Fictional killers only, no gore and no real crimes. Twelve questions about control, routine and being caught, and the BAU will name your archetype.

questions.prompt: The first page of your file says you are:

options.label: Extremely charming, which is the concerning part
Unusually organised
Theatrical, and aware of the audience
Unsolved, for eleven years
A spotless flat and a very specific routine
Every ticket, every receipt, boxed and dated

Nothing, and that is the point
Remembered fondly by the people who met you
Never mentioned in the report at all

results.name: THE CHARMER
results.blurb: Your whole method is access. You are warm, attentive and easy to trust, and people tell you things within twenty minutes of meeting you. Nothing about you reads as dangerous, which the file notes three separate times with increasing unease.
strengths: Never needs to raise their voice
results.watchOut: You use warmth to get past things. Mean it, or stop using it.

results.name: THE PERFECTIONIST
results.tagline: Everything in its place, including you
results.blurb: You are not chaotic and you are not impulsive. You are a routine, executed properly. The flat is clean, the calendar is colour-coded and the same small mistake would destroy you far more than any investigation. The profiler's note reads: 'more afraid of disorder than of consequences.'
results.watchOut: You will sacrifice the good thing to keep the tidy thing. Loosen one rule.

results.name: THE SHOWMAN
results.tagline: It isn't finished until someone reacts
results.blurb: You are not doing this quietly. The staging, the timing, the note left where it will be found first: it is all communication. You want the room to understand something, and you would genuinely rather be caught than be a paragraph nobody reads.
results.watchOut: You escalate for attention. Notice when the room has stopped watching.

results.name: THE GHOST
results.tagline: Eleven years, no photograph, no name
results.blurb: You leave nothing: no pattern, no receipts, no face in a single frame. You are the file that gets reopened every few years by someone certain there is something in it. You find the attention mildly funny, mostly because it has never once come close.
results.watchOut: Invisibility is safe and very lonely. Let one person find you.

results.name: THE COPYCAT
results.tagline: Familiar, but the details are wrong
results.blurb: You are less an original than a very careful reader. You take what worked, discard what didn't, and improve the parts everyone agreed were sloppy. Investigators keep almost matching you to someone else, which is the most flattering thing anyone has ever said about your work.
results.watchOut: You borrow other people's lives instead of building one. Start your own.

results.name: THE ONE WHO DID IT FOR FAMILY
results.blurb: Nothing in your file is about you. It is about a house, a debt and a person you would do anything for. You are not cold or theatrical or clever. You are simply loyal past the point where loyalty is a virtue, and the profiler finds that harder to explain than any of the others.
results.watchOut: You would ruin your life for someone who never asked. Check first.

results.name: THE COLLECTOR
results.tagline: Everything is labelled and nothing is thrown away
results.blurb: You keep things. Tickets, letters, a box in a cupboard with a date on it. The collection is not the crime; it is the proof that something happened and that you were there for it. The profiler's summary is one line: 'the archive is the motive.'
results.watchOut: You keep things to avoid feeling them. Open the box occasionally.
